products.what_it_changes: WP says the Cone Valve closed-cartridge fork gives smoother, less harsh front-end feel with more damping reserve for big hits, steadier damping and lighter CNC parts; fully externally adjustable.

products.caveats: Improves existing ss-010 (adds set number and per-model fitment). WP's 2024 press release (Cycle Canada) lists the same set number 0472C104U203220 'from 2018'. A newer set number A410C104Y203220 is sold for 18-26 (see next entry); check which one your dealer supplies.

products.what_it_changes: Same 7543 Cone Valve fork; AOMC lists external adjustment, higher bottoming resistance and friction-optimised parts.

gaps: Race Tech: racetech.com shows a 25 mm G2-R cartridge kit (FRCK DKTSX6509 00) and G3-S custom shock (RSDKT 04PRNN) for 'KTM 65SX', but gives no model years, so they were not recorded. No Race Tech page found for KTM 85 SX or 50 SX.
Öhlins: no 50cc or 65cc product found for KTM-group bikes; no Öhlins 85 fork beyond the FCX 0101 cartridge.
WP: no XACT PRO 7500/6736/8936 part numbers found for 2025+ 50/65 or for the new 2026 65cc fork; no WP 7548/8950 part numbers confirmed for 2025-2027 big bikes (dealers list 2023-2024 or '2023+').
WP KTM-height part number for the 2019-2022 XACT PRO 8950 shock not found (only the Husqvarna -10 mm 18150U07SET).
WP linkage: no WP/KTM PowerParts linkage part with stated fitment found (lowering kit 79612955144 has no fitment on the page).
Showa: no Showa A-kit or Showa conversion for KTM-group MX bikes found (only a Showa-to-WP XPLOR enduro kit, out of scope).
TBM, Dialed, Xtreme: no KTM-group suspension product pages found.
Pro Circuit, Enzo, MX-Tech, Technical Touch, REP, Luxon: nothing new for 50/65/85 found; their big-bike items already exist in suspension.json / suspension2.json.
